deploybot: PROD deploy kicked off for service=inference-runtime env=prod tag=v3.6.2 commit=bc12d9f2 strategy=gradual

deploybot: planned rollout steps = canary(10%) -> mid(50%) -> ramp(100%) ; health probes enabled

Maya: kicking off canary (10%). I'll watch p95 latency, error-rate, and GPU memory.

Alex: infra watching here. alerting up and dashboards pinned.

deploybot: canary traffic shifted -> 10% ; 4/4 pods ready ; smoke tests running

ops-bot: smoke tests: generate/checksum ✅

Priya: quick note - one canary pod reported OOM on a 1-in-100 long request pattern, restarted and came back healthy. looks isolated.

Maya: thanks Priya. holding 4m to validate no more OOMs, then advance.

deploybot: canary stable @ 4m. no 5xx spike and queue length flat. advancing to 50%.

deploybot: traffic -> 50% complete. autoscaler added 3 pods, metrics normal.

Alex: saw a brief p50 spike during the shift, likely cache warm. p95 unchanged.

Maya: okay to proceed to 100% if steady for 5m. tagging prod-pin=v3.6.2 to reserve.

Priya: running a targeted smoke suite against heavy seqlen requests. reporting back in 2m.

deploybot: traffic -> 100% on tag=v3.6.2 commit=bc12d9f2 :shipit: 

deploybot: Post-deploy checklist: ingress health OK ; p95 +2ms (within SLO) ; error-rate within baseline ; no new alerts

Maya: thanks team. creating follow-up ticket RN-358 for the rare OOM case and kernel-warmup tracking. cc @Alex

Alex: will triage infra signals and add dashboards for the warmup metric.

Priya: smoke suite passed all heavy-request scenarios. marking QA thumbs.

deploybot: PROD deploy complete. duration=11m 47s

Maya: closing deploy window. will post brief release note in #announcements after release doc goes up.

Alex: nice and clean. :tada:

Priya: filing PR to add a conservative pre-warm step for kernels tomorrow.

Maya: logging done in release tracker. all set.
